avis.texte: I was hesitant about trying a cream cleanser! And WHOA to my surprise! The best moisturizing cleanser! No more dry squeaky skin,,, and I am allergic to EVERYTHING and i experience no sensitivity with this one here. Easy to rinse.. ILOVE IT!

Please Ulta, dont stop selling this product. I have used it for several years now and nothing compares. My daughters are sold on it too. Takes off all my makeup and leaves my skin feel so soft and clean. Simply the best.

avis.titre: Great for my very sensitive skin (dermatitis)
avis.texte: Always had a hard time finding a face wash that didnt irritate my dermititis. Was previously using Cerave and this cleanser is cleaner, and actually makes a noticeable dofference.
Best cleanser ever So gentle and leaves your face feeling so soft
I love this cream cleanser, it makes my face so silky smooth. I will continue to purchase it, great product! Great company.

avis.titre: This stuff is great! It doesn't dry out my skin
avis.texte: This stuff is great! It doesn't dry out my skin. My face feels so soft and smooth. I don't need to use makeup remover either. Takes it right off.

avis.titre: I have been using this cleanser for a few months now and my
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser for a few months now and my face has done a 360! Most if not all dark spots and blemishes are gone. I get compliments at work how my skin looks healthy and that look younger than my age. It's a confident builder for a 50 year old male, Thank you Madd Hippie!

avis.titre: I had flare ups of adult acne
avis.texte: I had flare ups of adult acne.This cleanser keeps me clear! And IF I get a pimple or two, using the blemish cream keeps them from getting noticable, clearing them away entirely very quickly. And the cleanser is gentle so my skin feels soft and supple.

Sonce i started using this i woke up with swelling on both eyes. At fist i dint think anything if this but them realized the two days i did nit use this the swelling was going diwn. When i wentback to using it i woke up and couldt see out if my eyes from the swelling. There must be something in it that i am allergic to

avis.titre: Cleanser is great but please change the packaging
avis.texte: Cleanser is great but please change the packaging so it is more travel friendly!
I just keep coming back to this. If you wear waterproof makeup I would use their jelly cleanser instead but if not, this product is superb. My skin just soaks it up and feels so soft everytime.
This does not remove make up and it's only part of the double cleanse routine where is the cleaning oil at Ulta? Don't tell me Another product bites the dust!!

Ok, hear me out. This product is so smooth and creamy I decided to try it shaving my bikini line. The results? Amazing! No razor burn whatsoever! Highly recommended if you have sensitive skin and are prone to razor burn. Love this stuff!
This is so hydrating and softening. Really leaves my skin feeling soft. If you wear waterproof makeup you might need something stronger, but otherwise this product is perfect.

The perfect gentle cleanser! I've repurchased this three times now and will keep buying it as long as I can. It's amazing for double cleansing — removes residue without stripping my skin or causing breakouts. Leaves my face feeling clean, soft, and balanced every time.

This feels like washing with a face cream - i just love it! My skin feels super moistuirzed after using. I follow with the mad hippie vitamin C serum and then night cream before bed and when i wake my skin is just glowing

My skin likes this. I have sensitive acne prone skin as a 50 year old. This cleanser cleans all the stuff on my face off at the end of a long day with just one use. My face is soft not left greasy. After rubbing it around my face with my finger tips i remove it with a damp washcloth. Smell is herbal I think
I tried using this on its own and following cleansing with Mad Hippie's jelly cleanser and both were a disappojtment. Didnt cleanse well and my face felt like there was a residue.

I cannot be without this stuff! It is my all time most favorite cleanser. I just love the feel of it on my face. so totally smooth and luxurious!! I use it morning and night and it's become the best part of my day!!

avis.titre: Dried my face out the smell is terrible
avis.texte: I read such great reviews with this item, but as with all the other products I tried it is terrible. The first thing I noticed was the bad smell. The next problem is my skin is slightly sensitive and this product completely dried my skin out. I would not recommend any of their products unfortunately and I really wanted to like them.

One of my most hated ingredients was added to this formula. Carrageenan! WHY MAD HIPPIE?!!!! I've been using this cream cleanser for years, mainly in the morning when I'm not wearing make up. It never broke me out, helped balance pH level, didn't irritate if it got in your eyes. I LOVED it but unfortunately I will never be buying this again. Also the ingredient Titanium dioxide?!!! It's a shame that Mad Hippie is doing what most other companies do just to fill their pockets more.

Since entering my forties, my skin hasn't been the same. What used to work for me doesn't anymore. My face was feeling very irritated, oily yet dry, and I had a bunch of texture all over. I was at the end of my rope with all the skincare lines that I own. Until I remembered I bought this a while back. I started using this for my only cleansing step and my skin is loving it! I don't follow the recommended way to use this cleanser. I apply on dry skin, work it in for a bit, and then I add a little water to emulsify. I remove with a warm, damp reusable cotton round (I love the Garnier reusable face pads). It gets everything off, and my face feels clean and moisturized at the same time. The only con is I wish it came in a bigger bottle.

I swear by this cleanser. Super weightless and actually feels good to use on your face. Doesn't have all the extra ingredients most brands do. HIGHLY recommend to anyone, will be getting it as a gift too for all my friends and family to try.

I loved the way this cleanser feels, not stripping at all but makes the face feel clean, then I used the Jelly one after, I think this cleanser cleaned so well that I maybe didn't really need to double cleanse.

i do love this cleanser but i dont think it helps necessarily with acne prone skin or oily skin. i tend to use this cleanser more in the winter since it is so hydrating. im not too big of a fan that it doesnt really bubble up when washing my face, and it feels like you have to use a lot of product because of it. wish it came in a bigger bottle & bubbled more.
This product does not remove make up....double cleansed with this and I still had foundation on my face.
Been using this face wash for a couple of years and I love it! It's the only face wash that doesn't dry out my skin or make it breakout! I love Mad hippie!
I hughly recommend this face wash. I have struggled wifh acne and i couldnt find anyhting that cleared my skin up, but this did!

avis.titre: I will be buying this product again
avis.texte: Really like how it makes my face feel clean. I like the ingredients and how soft my face feels after using it.
Love this cleanser. Gentle on the skin, and with a pleasant scent. Amazing that it comes in a glass bottle !!!!!

I wanted this produce to work for me but it didnt :( I definitely have combination skin. I was using this in the morning and night. It is creamy and smooth but doesnt get foamy. Because of the lack of foam…I do not think it cleaned the oil from my skin before bed, result in breakouts.

Love the feel of it on my face. Nice and light. Not thick or heavy feeling. Also a nice light scent which is not over bearing. I usually go scentless with everything I purchase. I will continue to buy this in the future.
I love this cleanser. It leaves my ca e feeling soft and hydrated. I'm 52 and use it daily!!
I love this cleanser. It leaves my ca e feeling soft and hydrated. I'm 52 and use it daily!!

I have dry skin. This cleanser cleans my skin (leaves that clean skin feeling post-wash), moisurizes it, and eventually provided an even texture and tone to my skin. I ALSO have radiance in my skin. I noticed improvement from this product about 2-3 weeks of use. I never knew a face wash could make that much of a difference. I have used this product for 1 year now. Personally don't recommend for oily skin. Downside- can't travel with this bottle.
I LOVE this cleanser! It cleans my skin and makes it feel so moisturized! This creamy cleanser feels so good on my normal combination skin.

avis.titre: I got breakouts due to this cleanser
avis.texte: I wanted to like this cleanser so bad but I have been using it for a week now and started noticing pimples popping up out of no where. I know this from the cleanser because its the only new product I started using on my face. Also the scent is horrendous and my face feels oily all day after using it :(
I really love this face cleanser. The product doesn't dry the skin. Has a very cooling and refreshing feeling on the skin. Wish they had refill products so the glass jars could be reused.

love, love, LOVE this product. its so clean, creamy and leaves my skin so hydrated and this cleanser doesnt strip the skin. i have dry, sensitive, acne prone skin and this product works wonders for me. i wish that it did come in a bigger bottle, i use twice a day and this lasts me abt a month. not a fan of the pump like other reviews are saying it is a bit annoying but would recommend this brand to anyone with a similar skin type + likes clean natural ingredients for a great price!

I have incredibly sensitive skin, most products burn and cause a reaction. I wanted to change all my products to cruelty free and found this brand. I of course was super hesitant and figured I'd have to return it. Happily to my surprise all of their products are super soothing (using the super A, 2 nights in a row the first couple nights did cause my skin to flare but once I followed the instructions I can use it however now!). I have less breakouts and my skin is silky smooth! I'm in LOVE with this brand!!! Def recommend to a friend!

This is a nice cleanser that feels like a combo of cleanser and lotion. I like it especially in the mornings, but find it's not as great on its own as a makeup remover unless you use it with a washcloth if you're not doing a double cleanse routine (which I don't/dont want a lengthy routine with so many products). The Jelly cleanser seemed a bit better at makeup removal so could alternate between cleansers for morning/night. Only issue I found with this is the bottle cause once you get closer to the end the pump stops working and I have to find somewhere to leave the bottle upside down and unscrew it each time I want to use it which is a little annoying. Maybe a tube like the jelly cleanser would fix that though.

Love the way this product smells, feels, and works. It really helps with cleansing the skin and keeping it smooth. My acne-prone + sensitive skin doesn't always react the best with new products, but has done well with mad hippie. I plan on buying again.

Ive been using this for 2 weeks now. I have PCOS/ance prone, super senstive skin. I have been using clinque for years because anytime I have ever tried something new I either develop a painful rash, hives or breakout really badly. This cleanser has been gentle and doesnt leave my skin overly dry, which is why I tried it to begin with, but It cuts through makeup easily. I do still have to use a moisturizer. Hasnt clogged my pores or made me breakout at all. It doesnt really have any smell to it even though I wish it did. I paired it with mad hippie vitamin c serum and am happy with both.

avis.titre: Has my skin so soft after using
avis.texte: Because it doesn't lather up, but it does cover the face and remove the make up and softens the skin really love the way it makes the skin feel Repair in the face for my nightly and daily rituals

I love this stuff! I grabbed it during one of the by one get one 40% off sales just by chance because I needed a new cleaner. I didnt expect much because alot of time cleaners break me out. I was pleasently suprised however to find that that was not the case here! Its a lovely texture, cleans off all my makeup, and I havent had a single breakout. Some reviews say it doesnt sud… I feel like that should be ovvious as its a cream cleanser. Truly lovely and has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine.

I think this cleanser deserves a higher rating but the people have spoken. I really liked this cleanser with combo mature skin. It has a chamomile scent for sure. Its creamy but does lather. The bottle and pump are nice. A little goes a long way. For me, I like P&L better but I would choose this cleanser over indie lee or osea which have higher ratings. It does not come in a smaller size so it being less expensive is also a plus.

I have always used an oil free cleanser from a popular brand but it makes my face feel tight so I decided to pick up a bottle of MH cream cleanser and this stuff is amazing after one use my skin was so soft and it is the only cleanser I use now. I have just about the whole MH line and it all works so well on my skin I am 44 years old and my skin looks better than it did in my 20's and 30's!!

I use this product after the cleaning oil to give my face a good clean. I love the way it makes my face feel after. So many face washes irritate me, but this one makes me feel wonderful. I get so many compliments on my skin after finding Mad Hippie products. I can't wait to try more!

I love the cleanser. It's the bottle it comes in I don't like. First off I'm still trying to get the pump to pop up. Been twisting it in the correct direction and it just won't open. This happens with other products so not just here. I'll have to use the pump from my empty bottle. Luckily, I have one. Also, the pump doesn't get all the product when it gets low. I have to take off the top and pound it onto my hand. Change the bottle and I'll give it five

Cleansers have either stripped my skin so much it's made me either significantly more oily or way more dryâ this cleanser doesn't strip my skin at all and has resolved my combination skin! Plus it smells amazing.

This replaced my old cleanser that I could only buy online. This stuff is super lush and creamy, my only complaint is that it's not very thick. I feel like I have to add more than "normal" to get the desired effect. Love it otherwise.

I have very dry skin and this is the only face wash I've tried in my 39 years that doesn't leave my face feeling tight and parched after washing. It doesn't irritate my eyes like other cleansers can, it has a very light natural scent (I could even continue using it while pregnant and so many other smells made me nauseated!), and a little goes a long way. Plus it's packaged in easy-to-recycle (or reuse) glass! My only complaint: I wish there was an option to purchase refills, or at least a bottle without another pump. Getting a new black plastic pump with each new bottle seems wasteful. I do participate in the Mad Hippie recycling program, but I could easily be reusing the pumps instead of sending them off for recycling.
I love this face wash cleanser. I have used several different face washes and this one is by far my fav. It feels so smooth and clean and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. Highly recommend
I took off lid before using and immediately noticed smell. Am returning, do not want this on my face. Have very sensitive skin and if it smells this bad i prefer not to use it on my skin.

i have pretty dry skin and have tried lots of hydrating cleansers, each one i try doesn't really feel like my face is getting clean. this one changed the game though! it's so creamy and gentle but this one actually feels like my face is getting cleaner without stripping my skin, the clean ingredients are a plus as well!

avis.titre: Amazing Product! Iffy On the Packaging
avis.texte: This is my favorite Mad Hippie product and I can 100% see myself repurchasing this. I have combination skin that is oily around my nose and upper eyelid but dry everywhere else so a lot of cleansers can be quite stripping. I actually don't like products that get too foamy/bubbly for that reason. This is the most gentle and nourishing cleanser I have ever used. It moisturizes as it cleanses, doesn't foam up so you know there are no harsh surfactants. I you have very oily or acne prone skin this might not be your jam to really deep clean. I mostly use this as a morning cleanser because my skin is not that dirty in the morning but it's just enough to be refreshing, wash off the nighttime skincare products, and remove a bit of oil on my nose that builds up overnight. At night I found it also works as the first step in a double cleanse because it is oil-based so it can very gently breakdown my waterproof mascara and SPF. I usually use a different product for 2nd step at night to cleanse a bit deeper. Scent wise, it is a very subtle florally scent from the orchid extract. It is very non-irritating. Thankfully there is no citrus like most other MH products. Sensitive skin friendly!
Just got this yesterday and have used twice. Absolutely love this cleanser!! Took my makeup off and left my skin clean and not dry. Worth the money!!!!
I was so surprised by this cleanser! It doesnt tighten my dry skin after use. Gentle and leaves my skin feelinf hydrated.

I am obsessed with this cleanser, it is hands down the best I have ever used. I have combination skin and it moisturizes my dry areas without making the rest of my face oily. My skin feels so soft and my breakouts are pretty much non existent now. It also smells amazing. I'll never use anything else again.

I have been using this for about 6 mos now and I love it. I used to use Philosophy's Purity Made Simple until they once again changed the formulation and I started to break out. Since I have been started to use Mad Hippie no break outs and super happy face!! I now use all Mad Hippie products and love them all!

I have really been enjoying this cleanser. It really does seem to cleanse the skin without stripping! I've tried several cleansers that are supposed to be nonstripping‚ but they either make your face feel tight and dry or they felt like they didn't cleanse at all. But not this one! I use this as the second step in my double cleanse. It's such a treat with the way it feels and smells! And my skin has been looking a little bit less congested! I will repurchase this over and over- I can already tell after less than two weeks. I'm also so excited to try other products from this brand. I love that they offer terracycle for recycling and their packaging is so cute too.

I've bought this cleanser twice and I really like the formula. The major drawback for me is the pump. It is not very good and doesn't allow you to get all the product out. Once you get down to about 1/4 left, you have to take the pump off and shake it out. It feels like I'm contaminating the rest of the product when I do that. Not sure I'll buy it again just because the pump is such a hassle.
Slowly switching over to the Mad Hippie products. I love how they feel on your skin. The rate pretty well on the Yuka app for safe ingredients.

I have lots of allergies and this face cleanser does not irritate my skin and it cleans. I use it on clean skin (after removing makeup) and it clears my pores as well as leaving my face feeling hydrated. Does not feel like the oils are being stripped from my face. Feels like a lotion, does not lather. Other commenters mentioned the smell but I have never been bothered/even noticed. It is a brand that leans towards natural products so there is no added fragrances (which are bad for your skin). I have combination-dry skin and usually only 2 breakouts a month. Good for just getting your face washed.

It does not remove even light makeup. So you need to buy two cleansers if you wear makeup, and for the price, I would like one cleanser to get the job done on its own. Smell isn't great. It's a cream cleanser but I wish it got a little foamy. It doesn't. Like other reviews, it might be fine for your morning cleanse but it isn't fit for nighttime. I am returning.
I am someone who has very dry and sensitive skin. This changed everything! Thank you!

I was looking for a cream cleanser for wintertime, because my skin tends to get much more dry in the colder months. Decided to try this one and it was a waste of money. While it did remove regular makeup ok, it does not remove sunscreen or waterproof makeup well at all. Moreover, it was insanely drying for my skin…as soon as I rinsed it, my face felt like it was wrinkling up like a raisin! I thought I might just be battling an extra dry phase, so I continued to use it the next few nights only to find my skin becoming more and more dry. After 5 nights, my face was insanely dry, parched, and rough. I switched to LaRoche Posay Toleraine gentle cleanser, and after 2 nights, my skin began to normalize again thank goodness! If you have very oily skin that is NOT prone to dry patches or dehydration, this one from Mad Hippie may work for you…otherwise, if you're prone to any facial dryness or dehydration, stay far away from this one.

avis.titre: Noticed a difference in my skin
avis.texte: Got at ulta on a whim and really liked it. The price is high for the bottle size IMO, but with the product itself- no complaints. By the time I finished the smallest size one I could see an improvement in my skin brightness and evenness.

I have never loved a cleaner like this one. I've been using for around 4 months and it has an amazing effect on my skin. My skin has gotten clearer and stayed moisturizing during cold weather. Clean ingredients.

I got this as a cheaper option to the Dermalogica I usually buy...but this stuff smells awful. I've been using it when I pumice my feet because I can't stand the smell anywhere near my face. 3/5 stars as a foot cleanser though.

Cream cleanser that I love for morning routine. It is good for everyday use but need to remove makeup before or after to get all the makeup off. I bought this in pregnancy due to clean ingredients and have been using ever since. This is a go to for me. I wish there was a travel friendly bottle

I got this in pregnancy initially due to it being vegan and having great ingredients. It is great for morning/everyday use. It isn't the best at removing makeup but it can melt it away for the most part and then you use a remover or toner after or before. A go to for me but wish it came in a travel friendly container

avis.titre: Gentle hydrating cleanser that smells amazing
avis.texte: This cleanser is absolutely amazing if used as a gentle second cleanse in a double cleansing routine or as a morning cleanser when your face is already relatively clean and make up free. The feel and smell is luxurious, it's a stand out sensory experience part of my skincare routine that I enjoy. It leaves my face feeling cleansed but not dried out and does not leave any residue which is perfect for morning time use for me as I wanted something that will cleanse without stripping my skin. Will it do the heavy lifting of a cleansing balm or foaming cleanser? No, but that's not the purpose or formulation of this cleanser. I love it.

This is my all time favorite cleanser. I have dry skin and this leaves my skin feeling clean and dewey with no tightness. When removing makeup it does require a double cleanse but does not cause any eye irritation. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: love! smells amazing, leaves skin soft
avis.texte: This smells SO GOOD, great creamy texture and formula where a little goes a long way, and is so silky and luxurious feeling. super easy on skin, i like to use in the morning before doing my skincare routine or at night after taking makeup off. leaves skin so soft and clean

Being a bit of a product connoisseur, I have tried numerous cleansers. I always come back to this magnificent product. Even when others are excellent, none are comparable. This is always "Best in Show." It is gentle and does not foam. It does not remove makeup, so another product is needed for that (and this can be used as a second step when removing makeup, if desired). This is an excellent morning face cleanser and smells divine. I recommend this to everyone I love.

I love Mad Hippie but this cleanser is not it. It smells fine, like if floral were medicinal, but it feels like I'm washing with very hard water because my skin just doesn't feel rinsed clean. I'm using a small amount and don't live in an area with hard water. I have quite dry skin. This doesn't irritate me at all, but I honestly can't tell if it's actually cleansing either? Swing and a miss.

I found this cleanser when I was searching for CeraVe replacements. I like it better. It smells nice and leaves my face feeling fresh and soft. As far as I can tell, it doesn't cause me to breakout. But, I imagine it wouldn't take off makeup.
This is oily and does not get my skin clean. I'm not sure if I'm just used to harsher products or what...but washing my face after using this is not what I was expecting.

I've been using this cleanser since I got it about three months ago. I had high hopes since I love the brand, but unfortunately this doesn't clean my face. It's too oily and doesn't even get my mascara completely off :( I won't be purchasing again.

My skin was looking so terrible I thought I would need professional peels/treatments for it to ever be smooth again. This cleanser has been a gamechanger. After using this cleanser for about 5 day , my skin started looking so much better. Now my face is smooth and glowing, and all of the bumps and imperfections are gone! Definitely recommend this!!

avis.titre: Great for morning time before applying makeup
avis.texte: This face wash does not remove makeup very easily. I typically use this face wash in the morning before applying makeup and use a different one at night to remove it. I would buy again for a good morning cleanser.

I love Mad Hippie, but sadly don't love this cleanser. It doesn't remove my mascara (not waterproof mascara) and it really doesn't feel like it cleans my face at all. Feels oily after using too. Maybe their other cleanser would work better for me. My skin type is combination, but a bit more on the oily side lately.

avis.titre: Decent Cream Cleanser But Could Have Better Packaging
avis.texte: I have combination acne, dehydration prone skin and I had bought this from Ulta. The cleanser itself is very gentle and I use it as my second cleanser, so if I wore makeup or sunscreen I didn't really have to worry about whether or not that was being removed. The cleanser didn't cause any irritation, though it feels like it doesn't rinse off quite as completely as other cream cleansers, but that didn't seem to cause any breakouts. My biggest complaint and what will probably prevent me from buying this again is I really wish the tube to the pump was longer because near the end you start having to shake out the rest of the product and I don't have that kind of patience.

avis.titre: It wasn't good for my oily skin
avis.texte: I enjoyed the light feeling and also the good ingredients, but I have acne prone skin and it wasn't helpful for that, if you have dry skin this may be a good product, if you have oily skin i'd recommend a treatment with the cleanser.
I use this in the morning to was my face it's creamy feels good on skin

I love how it's creamy and gentle, but the one problem I have with it is that it's a bit expensive compared to other brands like CeraVe. Which isn't that much of a problem if it's high quality, which this is.
If you have issues with dry/combo skin this is the best morning cleanser it doesn't dry me out and it's super gentle. I use the oil cleanser at night because I usually wear makeup during the day

In my 41 years, I must have gone through about a dozen cleansers that claim to be non-drying and none of them worked until I stumbled upon Mad Hippie's cream cleanser. It is the holy grail of cream cleansers and keeps my dry, aging skin hydrated. I think I might finally be a product monogamist.

I am 50 y/o with dry/sensitive skin. Started this line about 3 wks ago and love most of the products in the line including this cream cleanser. It is hydrating, especially when used after the MH cleansing oil (which removes make up). It does not irritate my skin nor does it have an overpowering smell. Just a slight floral smell that fades quickly. The bottle is small but one squirt is plenty. It is quite concentrated, which I love! This is my new go-to!
Non drying and good ingredients! Feels healthier on your face

I'd give this zero stars if possible. People don't realize even water is a chemical. (Yep, it is. Chem formula is H20. Hydrogen and Oxygen.) I was on the "clean beauty" wagon before it was cool, but I fell off that wagon real quick. Those things that are to preserve products don't hurt as much as this stuff did! Give me Parbens! Get rid of Essential Oils! Anyway, waste of money. Sticking with CeraVe and Vanicream.

I just purchase probably my 8th bottle of this cream cleanser, I was sad to see that the ingredients changed. It feels a lot more slippery on my face, and I hate the fact there is carrageenan gum now. I am going to return this. Now I have to find a new face wash. This isn't the first Mad Hippie Product where I've seen the ingredients change and not for the better.

this did not work for me. I've tried for over a month now and I dread using it but I'm trying not to be wasteful at the same time. I don't feel like it cleans my skin and I can't tell any difference since using it. I've actually had to begin double cleansing because it does absolutely nothing. this is also the first time I've used a cream cleanser and I can say it's not for me. I have combo skin, some oily areas and some dryer areas and I would not recommend.

This cleanser is CHANGING my skin. I was hesitant because I have such, temperamental/reactive skin. First, I use an eye makeup remover with a cotton round. Second, I use 2-3 pumps of this lightly scented cream cleanser and massage it into my skin. Final step is to use a warm Terry washcloth to swab majority of product and makeup off. I use this technique because I dont like getting any cream (or oil) cleansers in my eyes. Then I rinse, pat dry et voila! beautiful, fresh & clean skin. Immediately followed by my serum and moisturizer. Truth be told, my skin has NEVER looked better! Impressive. I will definitely keep buying this!
The texture of this product feels amazing on my skin! The smell is pretty strong but nice. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed but also very soft and smooth! I'll definitely buy it again!

Listen, I have bought nearly every Mad Hippie Podcast there is. Why? Because I got hyperfixated on finding a company I wouldn't feel guilty buying from who actually were throughful in packaging sourcing etc. I have finally gone through almost everything and the one thing I can't stop thinking about is this cleanser. I'm 33 sensitive combo skin. My skin hates basically all cleansers. I find that most are too stripping. But after two years and adventuring into other cleansers, this is the procduct I'm coming back for. I used it up quicker than everything else....Also, their vit C is mind blowing.
I don't think I'll buy it again but it's ok. Soft. Smells nice. I didn't notice any improvement with my acne.

I first tried this a year ago in search for something very natural and I loved it! I got so many compliments on my skin clearing up. I stopped issuing it for a while but saw it was on sale and decided to try it again. Already I've noticed my skin clearing up and looking healthy. The only down fall is this is not a face soap so it doesn't lather at all but it does clean !!!

I have always had pretty dry skin and as I age it just gets worse. Sun, wind, and harsh winter weather hasn't help matters either. I have tried several skin care cleaners over the years and have really been on a quest for just the right one. I thought it would never happen. Truly, this is the first product that I have tried that feels like it cleans my face, but also leaves it smooth and nourished. I've never tried anything like it. My skin looks better and feels better. I really am just so thankful for the work you have put into it and I'm so happy that I tried it. I honestly think I will be a customer for life. Thank you.

avis.titre: Best cleanser ever, packaging kinda sucks
avis.texte: I never write reviews, but if they discontinued this cleanser I would cry. My skin stopped breaking out after using it. It's very moisturizing. I always take off my makeup before using it so I'm not sure how good it is at taking off makeup. I use it with a cleansing brush and its great because its gentle. The only thing I don't like is the packaging, because when it gets to the end there's still product left and it's hard to get to because of the pump.

I have sensitive, hormonal skin that refuses to behave. This cleanses without stripping... TRULY. I acknowledge that's a giant cliche, but this is the first product to actually deliver for me. I've accepted that my face will never be "normal", but now I'm at least comfortable and hydrated. As a bonus, this seems to stomp out hormonal acne. Kill it with kindness, I suppose? Please never discontinue this.

This cream cleanser is phenomenal. It removes my daily makeup , and leaves the softest feel to the skin. I use a makeup cloth "eraser" or soft washcloth to wipe off the makeup, and then rinse it with splashes of water. If you wear very heavy MU, you might need a separate remover. Using the MH Vitamin C and Exfoliating serums as well. Love.
I like all of the Mad Hippie products because of the ingredients in all of them. Love organics.
After hearing wonderful things about this cleanser, I have to say it's a fail for me. The fragrance causes my mature skin to react.
I have only used this cleanser ONCE and it left my combination skin clean and comfortable--there was no tightness whatsoever!! I am in love!
I use this for my morning cleanse and I absolutely fell in love! Quality ingredients and leaves my face so incredibly soft and moisturized for the day. I'm so happy I ordered a backup.

The smell is divine and it does a great job cleansing. I was surprised by the lack of an oily residue- especially for a cream cleanser. Rinses well, and skin is sooo baby-soft after using. Great introduction to the Mad Hippie brand!

I've been struggling with breakouts from 20-30 years old. Every product I tried seemed to irritate my skin even more. I decided to simplify my skin routine and focus on hydrating my face with natural products. This cleanser has cleared my skin so much I no longer wear makeup to work. Favorite product of all time.

It doesn't clean well enough and leaves behind an oily film. It's obvious, the first time I used it I knew it was one of *those* cleansers that doesn't actually cleanse. I appreciate that it's not stripping but I could not use this by itself I have to add my regular cleanser into this. It's very nice in conjunction with another harsher soap so I kept it. I use the kombucha andalou naturals typically & it's a little bit too stripping sometimes so a dab of both work pretty perfectly for me. It's not a terrible product it's just too oily. I actually would buy it again to use as a buffer in cleansing.

I love this cleanser, I have extremely dry skin and exclusively have been buying just this cleanser and the cleansing oil for the last three years. It's so hydrating and gentle for sensitive skin. I do wish that madhippie would consider selling the pump separately... it seems a little wasteful to have a pump with the cleanser every time I purchase, I would love to reuse just one pump and save on plastic! Other than that, it's a fantastic product I can't live without! Fingers are crossed for extra environmentally friendly steps with the product
It cleans and makes my face super soft and bright! Get this cause it does wonders on your pores and skin! Thank you!

I was gifted this cleanser and it was the first cream cleanser I have ever used and I was quite pleased with the performance of this product! Now I would not use only this cleanser if I had a face full of makeup but I would use this as a second cleanse. My face gets weird- one day I've got dry patches and the next day I am so greasy a bug would slid off my face! I really like to use this in the winter and when my skin feels dry. I really like that the products are natural, cruelty free and vegan! I love that they also have that Terracycle recycling program. I am definitely a big Mad Hippie skincare fan and I would definitely recommend this to anyone and everyone!
